_om: Nynneren in English (Humdinger, rusj.no/en/humdinger/). Key = the Norwegian text in spill.js. Hurtignynn is «Quick hum», Én om gangen «One at a time». The songs are in data.en/laater.json: titles only, no artists, songs British players know. Shared words come from rusj/kit/tekst.en.json.
